caption: The drawing features a wooden crucifix with a figure mounted on a cross. The cross is decorated with black and red designs at the ends of the beams. The central figure on the cross has brown skin, a dark beard, and short dark hair, wearing a patterned robe in shades of yellow, orange, red, and green with black outline accents and details. The arms are outstretched and nailed to the cross, and the figure's feet are together, also nailed. Below the crucifix, on the wooden base, there are eight smaller carved figures arranged in a row. These figures are painted mainly in red, black, and yellow, with four each on either side of the crucifix base. Most of them are facing forward and two hold objects; one has a drum and another appears to have a long staff or rifle. The background is plain, solid and off-white. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the central figure and cross dominating the scene, and the row of smaller figures beneath.
title: Bulto (San Acacio)
